== Description ==
The '''Roblox Mystery Figure - Cyber Medic''' was a character figure that can be obtained from the ''Roblox Celebrity Mystery Figure Pack - Series 7''. It was released on the 30th of January 2021. This toy was based on the former Level 5 {{Color|Premium|Cyber}} [[Medic]]. The toy is recommended for ages 6+ and is not suitable for children under 3 years old.

== Official Description ==
*'''From Roblox Celebrity Mystery Figure Pack - Series 7'''
*:Now you can assemble the ultimate Roblox toy collection with these iconic characters from your favourite games! There are 24 new figures from Celebrity Collection Series 7 and each comes with a code for an exclusive virtual item that can be redeemed on Roblox. Collect them all! Each sold separately.
*'''From Jazwares website'''
*:A halo is usually a symbol of good behavior, so behave! Get this exclusive item when you redeem a code from a Roblox toy!

== Prices & Stores ==
The ''Roblox Celebrity Mystery Figure Pack - Series 7'' has 24 figures that may be included. As you cannot guarantee what toy you get from the ''Roblox Celebrity Mystery Figure Pack - Series 7'', there is no fixed price for the '''Roblox Mystery Figure - Cyber Medic'''.

The rarity of this item is also unknown as each figure does not have the same rarity.

The costs and stores listed are for one purchase of the ''Roblox Celebrity Mystery Figure Pack - Series 7'', unless stated otherwise. Prices vary by country due to shipping costs and local currency. Generally, it costs around $3.99-$14.39 in the US, £3.99 in the UK and €4.99 in the EU. 

The stores in which you can buy the ''Roblox Celebrity Mystery Figure Pack - Series 7'' depends on each country. The toy is subject to availability.

The following list is a selection of the online stores that you can buy this item from. This is not meant to be a comprehensible list:

*[https://www.amazon.com/Roblox-Celebrity-Collection-Mystery-Exclusive/dp/B08FXPC2CW Amazon] (6-Pack, Worldwide)
*[https://www.walmart.com/ip/Roblox-Celebrity-Collection-Series-7-Mystery-Figure-Includes-1-Figure-Exclusive-Virtual-Items/594405260 Walmart] (US, Canada & Mexico)

==Trivia==
*The {{RLinkC|5122337480|Cyber Halo: Paramedic}} accessory, which is the virtual item that comes from this figure, does not appear in the game in any capacity.
**It was however a reference to the halo that the Level 5 {{Color|Premium|Cyber}} [[Medic]] used to have.
**The {{RLinkC|5122390423|Cyber Halo: Surgeon}} is a rare variant of this item that can be obtained from a chaser code. It can be found in any Roblox toy pack or mystery box.
